datasets: All eight subsets of the fixed three-user roster, conditioned on the same released output and public schedule.
full_window_projection: Sender preparation persists, no receiver fact or receipt appears, and authenticated denial advances persisted observed time. The internal PACKET_LOST transition represents only preparation/no-fact state; it is not emitted as an attacker observation.
recovery_selector: The legacy RECOVERY_CUT.operation field is the public route alias root for this composition, not a business operation id.
r15: receiver live count equals historical high minus retirement floor and stays in [0,1]
completed operation, charge, job and publication rows remain byte-identical
ticket identity and original lifetime remain unchanged
existing FINAL rows remain unchanged while new rows may append
accounting: Shared accounts may change for B; R2 checks the exact reservation/spend/release relation. R15 does not freeze aggregate accounts.
excluded: general cryptographic or DP composition proof
